answer: Every claim climbs the pearl of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the voyage re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, converted to a slow vesting stream, rewards vest against future work. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Reaching the canyon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
